name: KokoStudioInvitationStrip
prompt: Original raster UI skin for Koko, a thoughtful social conversation app. Restrained tactile paper/enamel style, deep petrol teal, pale mint, warm ivory and small coral accents. Orthographic front view, calm sophisticated social design, NO people, NO scenic illustrations, NO words, letters or numbers, NO double outlines, NO bevelled glass frame, NO cut-off corners, NO watermark. Actual transparent background outside the object. Complete shape nearly fills canvas with only 1% transparent margin. This is a production asset, not a phone screenshot or design board. Create one very wide compact horizontal 4:1 invitation strip, intact softly rounded rectangle. Pale mint tactile cardstock body, softly sculpted cream and deep-teal pair of overlapping speech-note slips integrated exclusively in the far left 15%, a tiny coral paper tab at that left edge. Blank clean center area occupying 70% for two lines of native UI copy. At the far right 8% draw one clear small deep-teal right-pointing chevron as part of the surface. No bottom illustration, no decorative leaves, no shadows extending far outside. Clear legibility at 330 by 84 points.
